name: revision_window_corrects_ignores_publisher_identity
detail: apply_revision_window() drops N1 (apple.com newsroom, the maker's real primary exhibit) because Y1 (The Verge, outlet tier) sets corrects='N1' within 24h -- even though Y1 is NOT from apple.com newsroom, the ORIGINAL PUBLISHER REVISION_WINDOW_V1's own clause text requires. Only Y1 (outlet tier, YES-favoring) is left admitted, which would flip the decisive tier and the money-determining verdict toward the taker's claim. admitted ids were ['N1'] (expected N1 to survive). Proposed fix: judge-proto/evidence.py apply_revision_window(), before treating `s` as a valid correction of `orig_id`, require by_id[orig_id]['publisher'] == s['publisher']; otherwise drop s (the fabricated 'correction'), never orig (the real original).
